name: KlimaLogg
description: Receive TFA KlimaLogg Pro sensors (30.3180.IT, 30.3181.IT) on ESP32 with an SX1276/RFM95 radio (OOK at 868.3 MHz, decoded in software), and talk to the KlimaLogg Pro base station (30.3039) like its USB transceiver: current readings, history download, clock.
